استلفن (form VIII)
# اِسْتَلَفْنَ (istalafna) /is.ta.laf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# اُسْتُلِفْنَ (ustulifna) /us.tu.lif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# اِسْتَلِفْنَ (istalifna) /is.ta.lif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
